subject: QuantifyAI — post-call model-fit recap & prompt-sample request
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@quantify.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@quantify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: QuantifyAI — post-call model-fit recap & prompt-sample request

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for the product demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a request so we can run a short model-fit evaluation for your summarization/answering workflow:

What we heard
- Primary goal: transform analyst notes + internal dashboards into concise, attribution-aware answers for sales engineers.
- Volume: ~300–600 requests/day today, spikes to 4k during reporting cycles.
- Latency target: P95 < 450ms for interactive flows; background batch okay for longer runs.
- Data sensitivity: product names and internal IDs are fine; some prompts will include customer PII (emails) and transactional values — you'll want redaction.

What we'll propose for an initial eval
1) Recommended candidate families: Mistral-Instruct-7B (cost-effective), Llama-3-70B-Chat (best quality for reasoning), and a quantized Falcon-40B variant for throughput tests. We will also evaluate a distilled 13B if latency constraints dominate.
2) Benchmarks we’ll run: ROUGE/EM for extractive QA, factuality checks (entity fidelity), P95 latency, and per-token cost estimate.
3) Deliverables: short report with recommendation, per-prompt metric breakdown, and a playback of failure cases.

What we need from you to start
- A 50–100 sample prompt set (CSV preferred) with: prompt text, expected answer (if available), label for sensitive content (PHI/PII/None), and a short note of the intended behavior. We attached a prompt_template.csv to make this quick.
- A handful (5–10) of edge-case prompts where hallucination or redaction is particularly consequential.

Attachments & links
- prompt_template.csv (attached) — quick columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output, sensitivity_label, notes
- We’ll upload the results to this Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmark/quantifyai-eval-2028 (we’ll share access once we start).

Next steps
- If you can share a first batch by EOD Mon (June 10), we can run a 48–72h smoke eval and reconvene with findings the week of June 17.
- If you prefer, we can run an initial run on synthetic variations we generate from your examples to show signposts faster.

Quick ask: please send the CSV or drop samples inline in a reply — and flag the edge-case prompts.

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production

--
Attachment: prompt_template.csv (3 KB, CSV stub)

From: Olivia Zhang <olivia@quantify.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@quantify.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantifyAI — post-call model-fit recap & prompt-sample request

Thanks Vivek — great summary. Tom and I pulled together an initial batch and attached a CSV (quantify_prompt_samples.csv). A few notes inline: 

- File includes 58 prompts across QA, summarization, and reranking.
- We flagged 12 prompts as "sensitive" (emails, small billing amounts, account IDs).
- Edge cases called out in column 'notes' — e.g., multi-turn followups, contradictory context, and very long table snippets.

Quick questions: 
1) For redaction, do you recommend we strip emails and replace with <EMAIL> tags before we send, or send raw and have Redwood run redaction?
2) Can you confirm whether you’ll run the first pass on our hosted dataset or provide a synthetic redacted copy?

Tom — looped in in case he wants to add.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aiming to get this to you today.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Data Product, QuantifyAI

--
Attachment: quantify_prompt_samples.csv (24 KB, CSV stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@quantify.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantifyAI — post-call model-fit recap & prompt-sample request

Thanks, Olivia — these look great. Quick answers to your questions: 

- Redaction recommendation: please send two variants if possible — (A) raw (internal-only) and (B) redacted with tokens like <EMAIL>/<ID> for any PII. Sending both helps us verify that automatic redaction rules don't remove context you need. If you can’t send raw we can still proceed with redacted only, but expect a narrower set of checks for entity fidelity.
- Execution mode: we prefer to run the initial benchmark inside Redwood Dedicated staging (we can ingest your samples into an ephemeral workspace). If you require, we can instead run over a redacted dataset you host and provide an API; tell us which is simpler for your security team.

Also sharing a short redaction guide (redaction_guidance.pdf) that we use for customers — it has examples of patterns we recommend and how to label edge cases.

If you’re comfortable, Vivek and I suggest a 30-minute touchpoint Tues (June 11) 10–10:30 PT to confirm which candidate models to prioritize for the first run. I’ll prepare a short evaluation checklist.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redaction_guidance.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@quantify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@quantify.ai>
Date: Sat, 09 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantifyAI — post-call model-fit recap & prompt-sample request

Perfect — thanks for getting the CSV over, Olivia. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 

1) We'll ingest the raw CSV into a temporary staging workspace (access-limited) on Monday morning. If QuantifyAI prefers we run against your hosted redacted extracts instead, say so by EOD Sun and we will pivot.
2) First smoke eval: Mistral-Instruct-7B, Llama-3-70B-Chat, Falcon-40B-quant (quantized) — prioritizing the Mistral/Llama pair for quality vs cost tradeoffs.
3) Deliverable ETA: initial metrics + 8–12 failure-case examples by Thurs (June 13). Full write-up and recommended production profile by Fri (June 21) if all goes well.

Meeting: we’ll hold the 30m Tue 10–10:30 PT to confirm model priority and access method. Invite sent separately.

Small ask: if you have any prompts that include multi-document context or reference tables, please label them with 'multi_doc' in the notes column — those have different cache/latency characteristics and we’ll want to flag them in the report.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
